findings.summary: takeMaxFlux contains a provably dead statement — `if (unread === 0 && this.latest) unread = 0;`. CONFIRMED, but verification found a REAL bug underneath it and recommended explicitly against deleting the line.
findings.change: Code unchanged. Documented the ring-wrap aliasing as @bug PRODUCTION, recorded why the dead line is deliberately left in place, recorded why `unread = 1` is NOT the fix, recorded that the routine no-new-snapshot tick is an honest zero, and added an @invariant that this file has no guard coverage at all.
findings.verification: The verifier confirmed the statement is dead by inspection (single assignment from a pure arithmetic expression, no intervening mutation, plain-field guard, RHS equals the value the guard proves). It then went further with a probe against the real class. (a) THE REAL BUG: the modulo ALIASES at exactly RING_SNAPSHOTS unread hops — `(ringWrite - cursor + 512) % 512` is 0 both when nothing is unread and when the writer has lapped the reader by exactly one ring. Measured: 512 unread hops all carrying flux 30 produced a max fluxRate of 0. The dead line's shape ('we computed zero unread, yet we do have data') fits a half-written fix for exactly that, intended body `unread = this.ringCount`. (b) REFUTED the obvious alternative: `unread = 1` would be wrong, because when the cursor has caught up `ring[ringWrite]` is the slot about to be overwritten — the OLDEST entry. Measured as 2.84s stale. (c) The routine case is fine: a no-new-snapshot tick is an honest zero, since the onset was already delivered at full max when its batch landed and ModulationEngine's attack/decay envelope carries it forward; batches arrive at ~53/s so zero-drain ticks are routine (~12% at 60Hz, ~63% at 144Hz). (d) COVERAGE GAP: no debug suite imports WorkletAnalysis — the three that mention it do so only in comments — and all five audio suites pass identically whether the line reads `= 0`, `= 1`, or is absent. test:audio-signal sets filterBank.fluxRate directly and hand-reimplements update(), deliberately omitting the drain.

notes:
COVERAGE — depth over breadth, per the brief. FULLY COVERED: modulation/** (all 6 files end to end), audioMod/** non-UI (AudioAnalysisEngine, AudioTransport, WorkletAnalysis, filterBank, bandMath, freqScale, index, worklet/protocol, worklet/analysisProcessor, dsp/bandAnalyser, dsp/autoGain — every @invariant checked against code), features/{index,types,setFeature}.ts, debug_tools/**, webcam/index.ts. NOT REACHED, no invariant work done: audioMod/AudioPanel.tsx (736 lines), AudioSpectrum.tsx (479), AudioLinkControls.tsx (227), webcam/WebcamOverlay.tsx (408), features/ui.tsx, post_effects.ts, color_grading.ts, modulation/paramMapping.ts, dsp/fft.ts, dsp/spectrumFrame.ts. The UI files in particular are untouched and worth a later pass.

INVARIANTS VERIFIED CORRECT (recorded so a later cycle need not redo them): AudioTransport's seven all hold — mic connects to inputGain only and never to destination, system audio connects to BOTH, captureConstraints sets echoCancellation/noiseSuppression/autoGainControl all false, inputGain sits between live source and analysisBus not on masterGain, init() short-circuits on this.audioContext. WorkletAnalysis's Response/Detail budget arithmetic is exact: at s=0.8, -(1/60)/ln(0.8) = 0.0747 = DEFAULT_SMOOTHING_TAU_SEC 0.074, and the '~118ms total / ~43ms centroid / 85ms window' figures all compute correctly at 48kHz; the audio/index.ts claim that 0.8->0.5 means '~118ms -> ~67ms' checks out (66.7ms). protocol.ts's '~56 levels + 56 flux' is exactly right and '2048 raw bins' matches fftSize 4096. holdsLiveSession: (live) => !!live.isEnabled correctly returns false when idle, and test:session-hold [3] pins the boot/share-link hydration path.

GUARD HEALTH — three falsification probes, all reverted with targeted Edits and re-confirmed green. (1) holdsLiveSession: () => true on ModulationFeature -> test:session-hold failed 5 assertions across all five sections. (2) Emptying RENDER_STATE_MERGED_FEATURES -> test:modulation-coverage [2] failed, correctly naming optics.camFov and optics.orthoScale as newly display-only. Both guards bite hard. (3) Read every assertion in parity/coverage/session-hold/audio-signal/filterbank/band-analyser: every collected value feeds an assertion — no dead collection found, unlike cycles 1-3. One weak spot noted rather than fixed: test-audio-signal [9] ('transient response does not depend on the tick rate') is near-tautological today, because processAudioSignal's transient branch never reads delta — it would only catch a regression that reintroduced a per-frame division, which is admittedly the regression it was written for.

HYGIENE: no @bug or @stale markers existed anywhere under engine/features/** before this pass. orphans is clean for the subsystem (engine/features/** has zero). No ADR was opened for writing.
